testing_mode: UPDATE

## Goal
Add single new function `_state_record_failed_run_id <run_id>` to `plugins/dso/hooks/lib/merge-helpers.sh`.

## Implementation
Use the existing python3 atomic write pattern already established in the file (env var injection, no shell interpolation). The function writes `failed_run_id` as a new optional field in the state JSON file.

Pattern to follow: look at `_state_write_phase` or `_state_record_pr_info` in the same file for the exact python3 write pattern.

## Verify
Use the BRANCH pattern to derive the state file path (matching the existing test convention):
```bash
local _branch_safe="test-branch-t4a-$$"
local _state_file="/tmp/merge-to-main-state-${_branch_safe//\//-}.json"
rm -f "$_state_file"
export BRANCH="$_branch_safe"
# Initialize state file first (required by _state_record_*):
_state_init 2>/dev/null || true
_state_record_failed_run_id TEST123
grep '"failed_run_id"' "$_state_file" | grep -q 'TEST123'
```

## Files to modify
- plugins/dso/hooks/lib/merge-helpers.sh (existing — add 1 new function)

## Known remaining issue (iteration 3/3 limit reached)
T3 test `t_state_record_failed_run_id_writes_to_state` (test 1) and `t_phase_poll_records_failed_run_id_on_ci_failure` (test 2) must use this same BRANCH-based pattern to assert state file contents. Confirm those tests use `BRANCH` env var setup, not `_STATE_FILE`.
